profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record, named "Verizon North Las Vegas" and tagged telecom=data_center, is located in North Las Vegas, Clark County, Nevada. Verizon Communications is a real, major, publicly traded US telecommunications company headquartered in New York City, formed through the 2000 merger of Bell Atlantic and GTE, but its legacy wireline network only serves as the incumbent local carrier in nine eastern states, and Nevada is not among them. That makes a traditional Bell-heritage telephone central office an unlikely explanation for a Verizon-attributed building here, with a Verizon Wireless mobile switching center or other nationwide cellular network facility a more plausible category, since Verizon Wireless operates infrastructure across the entire country regardless of Verizon's separate wireline footprint. No address, capacity figures, or independent news coverage could be located, since search-tool quota was exhausted. A separate, unrelated "Verizon" record also exists elsewhere in Clark County, roughly 8.5 miles away, confirmed to be a genuinely distinct location rather than a duplicate of this one, though its own specific function is equally unconfirmed. This entry is filed as an honest, unresolved case, most plausibly Verizon network infrastructure rather than a commercial colocation data center, without asserting fabricated specifications.
